title: Files, folders & cloud sync
blurb: OneDrive, iCloud, Dropbox, lost or deleted files, search, file types.

remedies.title: Turn OneDrive folder backup on or off (Desktop, Documents, Pictures)
remedies.why: OneDrive can keep your Desktop, Documents and Pictures in the cloud automatically.

steps.text: OneDrive icon › Settings › Sync and back up › Manage back up.
Turning it off leaves a copy online; files on this PC start empty unless you copy them back.

remedies.escalate: Work PCs often require backup to stay on.

remedies.title: OneDrive is signed in with the wrong account
remedies.why: OneDrive can hold one personal and several work accounts; files go to whichever folder you use.

steps.text: OneDrive icon › Settings › Account › Unlink this PC, then sign in with the right account.
Work files belong in "OneDrive - <Company>", personal in "OneDrive - Personal".

remedies.title: Send a really large file (several GB)
remedies.why: Email can't carry big files; cloud links can.

steps.text: Upload to OneDrive/Google Drive/iCloud/Dropbox and share a link.
Use a USB drive for very large or private transfers in person.
At work, use the approved sharing tool rather than public transfer sites.

remedies.title: A file is damaged or won't open after copying
remedies.why: The copy didn't finish, the drive was pulled out, or the download was interrupted.

steps.text: Copy or download it again from the original.
Get an older version from OneDrive/iCloud version history or a backup.
Check the drive it came from for errors.

remedies.title: Share a folder with another person on this computer
remedies.why: Each user's files are private; a shared folder lets everyone reach them.

steps.text: Use C:\Users\Public, or right-click a folder › Properties › Security to add users.
Use /Users/Shared, or Get Info › Sharing & Permissions.

remedies.title: Find and remove duplicate files
remedies.why: Copies from phones, downloads and backups waste space.

steps.text: DeskZero (a sister DeskLab app) finds exact duplicates and moves them aside safely.
Photos apps can merge duplicate photos (Mac Photos › Duplicates).
Check the Disk map for big repeated folders.

remedies.title: My Downloads folder is a mess
remedies.why: Everything you download lands in one folder.

steps.text: Sort by Date and delete installers and old files you no longer need.
DeskZero can sort Downloads into folders by type or rules automatically.
Storage Sense can clear Downloads files older than N days.
